==Famous?==
Are [[Galad]] and [[Canvele]] really ''famous''? — [[User:Fbstjoe|fbstj]] 10:49, November 19, 2010 (UTC)
:Canvele, no. Galad, I would say yes. He rose in the ranks quickly, and became a fairly young, if not youngest, Lord Captain Commander. He is also a highly accomplished swordsman and a pretty good tactician. Canvele looks like a one-time character. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 18:51, November 19, 2010 (UTC)
::I get that he's good, but is he really ''famous'' or will he be considered famous in the next age? — [[User:Fbstjoe|fbstj]] 19:31, November 19, 2010 (UTC)
:In my opinion, yes, I think he can be considered famous. Fame can be in the here-and-now, not just something for the history books. He's got the respect of most of the Children (at least all of those not under Seanchan rule) and he's got the respect of the leaders of the Goldeneyes Companions. That's my take on in anyway. Also, I've never been a fan of listing people on pages like this when there is a category for them. But that is another discussion. :) ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 23:20, November 19, 2010 (UTC)
